grid.reason: one shared nonoverlapping grid contains all alpha>128 actor components; intentionally not raw dimensions divided into equal rows

manifest.globalBiasDefinition: componentwise median of baseline painted-clasp minus actual native-clasp across43 measured rows (including higher-uncertainty partials); preserves robust baseline style placement, ONE constant, not a new trajectory
manifest.nativePathDefinition: target_i=actual projected native Hips-bound clasp_i/2 + constant bias; source path/tempo unchanged
manifest.pivotDefinition: delta_i=nativeTarget_i-(fixedS*paintedManualClasp_i+fixedT); ONE full-frame translation, no per-frame scale or warp. Standard drawn-cel metadata candidate, NOT recovered physical Root.

heldOutBowTrajectoryCenteredRmsNativePx.meaning: descriptive variance after removal of each curve constant mean; not a fitted pivot/bias, not used for any correction or acceptance

limitations: 43 painted clasp annotations uncertain; 5 null positions remain unmeasured. The native target path is unchanged, but painted clasp alignment on those five phases is not verified.
5occluded pivots estimated by short-run interpolation, uncertainty unknown.
12sparse bow annotations held out; no independent all48head/knee/foot fidelity proof.
Fit-point coincidence does not establish smoothness or absence of slow drift. Actual browser/video inspection required.
Underlying pose/silhouette/style errors remain; no artwork pixels changed.
Illustrated heading is closer to true profile than the native rear-three-quarter view; no heading fidelity certification.
Painted soles/contact are unverified; artist pivots are not physical Root or no-slip certification.
